entities.name: Hellspurs
entities.description: An outlaw gang that announces a job opening and unleashes new members on a town.

entities.name: Sterling Company
entities.description: A company that expands its territory and employs mercenaries, enforcers and agents.

entities.name: Akul
entities.description: A Hellspur leader who disposes of a would-be usurper.

entities.name: Honest Rutstein
entities.description: A local purveyor with a no refunds policy.

events.summary: Akul disposes of a would-be usurper among the Hellspurs, leaving the sheriff to piece things together.
Sterling Company expands its territory again.
Honest Rutstein strengthens his no refunds policy.
events.quote: Local Purveyor Honest Rutstein Clarifies, Strengthens "No Refunds" Policy
